data.title: Kindergeld decision: €259/month for Clara from October 2026
data.summary: The Familienkasse Musterfulda confirms continued child benefit (Kindergeld) of €259.00 per month for the daughter Clara from October 2026, since she has started studying at Hochschule Beispielfulda. The letter also asks for a new certificate of enrollment at the end of the summer semester and explains the one-month objection period.
data.explanation: This letter sets the monthly child benefit for Clara at €259 starting October 2026, now that she studies at university. You should keep submitting a new certificate of enrollment (Studienbescheinigung) at the end of each summer semester to keep the benefit running. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the Familienkasse — the app shows until when. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final after that window. No immediate payment is required from you.
